title: Single-tape transition action
statement: Let $i$ be one of the $k$ work tapes, let $u$ be a movement of the input head, let $w$ specify an optional write value for the selected tape (a symbol, blank, or no write), let $m$ be its head movement, and let $q$ be a state. Define an action that moves the input head by $u$, applies $w$ and $m$ to tape $i$, leaves every other work tape unchanged with its head stationary, emits no output, and enters state $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $k$ work tapes
$u$ is a movement of the input head
$w$ is an optional write instruction, allowing a symbol, blank, or no write
$m$ is a movement of the selected work-tape head
